top_choice_rationale: Gray and Winkler established experimentally, with ruthenium-modified proteins, how electrons tunnel over about 20 angstroms through a protein and how the rate depends on distance, driving force and reorganization energy, plus multistep hopping through Trp/Tyr chains. This is a physically stated, decades-confirmed mechanism that underlies respiratory and photosynthetic enzymes, with a clean two-person allocation. P001 follows because the principle is real and measured, but the PROTAC strand lacks an approval and three names force a contestable cut; P002 is mature and cleanly attributed but close to the 2010 prize; P004 has a messy credit history and sits near Medicine; any award is preferred to none.
recusal_note: Field proximity only: B006 is in biological electron transfer, close to my own work on respiratory enzymes, which could be seen as a conflict requiring recusal; no personal or institutional tie to the candidates is apparent from the profile.
